blocks.text: SAN ANTONIO — San Antonio star Victor Wembanyama spent many uneasy nights this offseason revisiting the Spurs’ loss to the New York Knicks in the NBA Finals. For an athlete fully committed to a regimented schedule of diet, exercise and a preferred bedtime of 9 p.m., the restless evenings were telling. Wembanyama was hurting. So, Victor did what Victor does.
